title: [Extensibility Request] issue 29640: use document type enum in blocked customer event
summary: Blocked customer check event now passes the extensible Gen. Journal Document Type enum value instead of converting to an option integer, preserving document type extensibility.
key_points: Changed OnBeforeCheckBlockedCust event parameter from option to Gen. Journal Document Type enum
Removed integer conversion to preserve enum extensibility for extensions
Applied to W1 and all 10 country layers consistently
Enables extensions to use custom document type values without reduction to integer
quote: Extensions need the blocked-customer check to preserve extensible general journal document type values.
